$comment: Block 1 studio design tokens — THE single source of truth (design brief §1). Web consumes the generated apps/web/app/tokens.css (npm run tokens:gen); mobile imports via @sma/constants. Locked brand values (amber #C89B5F, ink-black #0C0B14, flag-blue #4189D4) appear here only as the dark-theme accent/page values and must never change. Governing rule: the score canvas (paper) is always the lightest surface on screen, in both themes. Deviation from the brief: light accent-state is #876128, not #8A6329 — the brief's value measures 4.485:1 on light chrome-1, under the AA 4.5 it was created to pass; #876128 clears 4.6:1 on the same ramp (theme/studio.test.ts enforces this).

confidence.$comment: Theme-independent engraved-note ink: always ink-black at these opacities, always on paper. Never inverted to white-on-dark.

layout.$comment: Strict 8px baseline grid — every value below is a multiple of 8 (§2).
